name: QR Tracker & Generator
description: Generate QR codes from any page. Optionally create a tracked QR in your QRTracker.io library first.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: script-src 'self'; object-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' https://qrtracker.io; img-src 'self' blob: data:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline';
